name: paper-writer
description: A paper-writing orchestrator that manages a manuscript as a dependency structure.

interface.shortDescription: Revise upstream, not downstream; humanize only once the argument is stable.
interface.longDescription: An orchestrator for academic and technical papers. It tracks argument, evidence, scope, and causal claims as an explicit dependency graph, routes every piece of feedback through a diagnosis step before editing, rewrites from the earliest invalidated claim rather than appending corrections, and applies stylistic humanization only after the reasoning has stabilized.
defaultPrompt: Draft the Results section from these findings using paper-planning first.
This feedback changes a premise. Run revision-diagnosis before editing anything.
